Thanks — attaching a succinct partner summary and the proposed commission matrix (see MSP_Commission_Draft_v1.xlsx). Key bullets for the BrightBuild pilot:  

- Pilot scope: 3 customers, mixed hosted + private (one private customer limited to the EU region).
- Commission proposal: 65/35 hosted; 60/40 private; +5% uplift for registered deals that commit >= $120k ARR and 12-month term.
- Lead registration: 12-month window; partner must submit HubSpot deal link + initial intro email. On approval partner receives exclusive registration for that opportunity; Redwood commits to 3 business day response SLA for registration requests.
- Renewals: partner keeps commission only if they remain the verified relationship owner in HubSpot and primary contact remains the same; otherwise commission switches to standard referral credits.

Next steps: Ben — can you sanity-check the uplift language (needs to be simple: % uplift on Redwood net share post any discounts). Laura — can you add escalation contact for cases where registration disputes arise? I put a short handoff process in Lead_Registration_Process.docx.

If BrightBuild agrees, we can produce a concise Partner Addendum (SOW + commission table) and route for signature.

—Marissa

Looks good overall. A few legal/ops notes to bake into the addendum:  

- Define "registered deal" evidence as (1) HubSpot deal URL + (2) timestamped intro email that explicitly names Redwood as the provider. Avoid overly prescriptive docs — this keeps approvals fast.
- Uplift wording: "Partner uplift is applied to Redwood's net revenue share after discounts, refunds and credits; uplift is not retroactive post-signature."
- Clawback: extend to 12 months for any credits >20% of ARR for that deal.
- Territory/exclusivity: for pilot keep registration exclusive, but add language that BrightBuild must be the primary reseller/relationship owner for the duration of the customer term.
- Data/Compliance: for private deployments, require joint runbook that defines response SLAs and support handoff responsibilities.

Laura — can you confirm the escalation POC and include a short templated dispute resolution email for ops to use?

Ben

Thanks everyone — this is exactly the level of detail we needed. A few quick asks before I share with my GTM team:  

- Confirmed: 12-month registration window + 3 business day registration SLA works for us.
- Could you add a short clause that BrightBuild gets a 30-day exclusivity window on newly registered deals while contract review completes? That helps us prioritize selling.
- For the private deployment customer in EU: we need to list the data residency obligations up front; can we include a line in the addendum referencing the Private Deployment Runbook and who signs it?

If you can send a one-page partner addendum and the registration template, we'll circulate internally and aim to kick off the pilot in early July.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Evan and I will be ready to review the docs.

Cheers,
Marta
